fixtureSource.groundTruth: Frozen sidecar benchmark/visual/action-state-sidecar.json; same 14 cases as the primary run.

limitations: Calibration uses the same 14-case partial corpus as the primary run; it inherits the same three missing states (processing, blocked, auth_required).

The two formulations are not directly comparable on accuracy alone: the 7-way choice question is asked to discriminate 7 states while the noul question is asked a single binary question. The useful comparison is the false-positive-success behaviour, which is equal at 0, and the abstention behaviour, which differs sharply.
status: calibration-only; not part of the primary gate run

comparison.interpretation: The binary noul question is strictly more conservative: it never answered success on any of the 13 non-success frames (false positives 0, same as the choice formulation) and it is more accurate overall (0.93 vs 0.64). Its cost is a single false negative: it answered false on the one genuine success frame with p=0.010, i.e. the binary axis cannot express the completed-vs-still-running distinction and defaults to abstaining. For a post-action verification gate this bias is the safe direction, but the recall loss on true successes is a real cost that a 31-case corpus would have to quantify.
comparison.caveat: noulSummary.falsePositiveSuccessRate is null in this file because the shared summarize() success-taxonomy check keys on the literal string success, which a boolean-expected case never carries. The confusion matrix above is computed from the raw rows and is the authoritative figure.

provenance.imagePreprocessing: PNG bytes read from disk and inlined verbatim as a base64 data URL; no resize, crop, re-encode or normalisation is performed by the harness.
provenance.rerunCommand: VISUAL_BACKEND=systemone VISUAL_MANIFEST=benchmark/visual/action-state-calibration-manifest.json VISUAL_FIXTURE_ROOT=benchmark/visual VISUAL_ENDPOINT=https://api.codiv.ai/v1/systemone VISUAL_MODEL=openjev-latest VISUAL_API_KEY=<operator key> npm run visual:spike
provenance.credentialHandling: The provider key is supplied by the operator through the environment only. It is never read from this repository and never persisted in any committed artefact.
